title: Wanting to be a trumpeter and learning drums
summary: Howard says he always wanted trumpet, taught himself drums by watching, and discusses bass drum beating.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Getting my first drums, with or without lessons

blocks.x: I was going to ask about a few of the other old time trumpet players since you probably, did you watch mostly the drummers when you were a kid or what interests you most, drummers or the trumpet players?

Well, I always wanted to be a trumpet player from a kid. But like I told you, I finally wanted to tell them that I could play the drum and I got jammed up there and I had to get up there and do something. So I started to play the drum. But the trumpet was what I always wanted. But the part was about the thing, just like driving an automobile. And nobody showed me to drive an automobile. I sat there and looked and I see the guy, what did he do? So I'd get in there and go do that. You see, the same thing with the drum. I'm looking at it, what did he do?
I didn't make no mess up or nothing of that sort.
In the old days when you started or even before when you watched the drummers, did they most of them use a four beat or a slower two beat bass drum?

Well, it depends on the tune he was going to play. It's a number. See, now if they're going to play well, if they beat that one beat like that. See? Now, like a lot of drummers right now, I know that's the way you're supposed to play. Yeah, I'm talking about that. But if you get tired, you can ride it, but you got to know what you're doing, you're going to ride it like that. You know what I mean? Well, that's the time of your rest. That's all the rest period, you see? But I can't change it in that quick for the keep up.
But, yeah, that's right. Like that. Just use your whole leg. That's right. It does make it a little easier in this. Yeah.
Well, and a lot of real drummers that play in it every day, they beat from their toe.
